description: Comboios suprimidos is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by VOST  PORTUGAL. Deleted trains. Coverage: VOST  PORTUGAL. The portal shows the English title as "Deleted trains" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is VOST  PORTUGAL. Its keywords include suprimidos, comboios. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2021-03-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
